newsitem.title: GREECE: Greek fx forwards dip on expected tighter rate gap.
newsitem.headline: Greek fx forwards dip on expected tighter rate gap.

text.p: Greek depos were holding but forex forwards were trading 30 forward points lower in long tenors as players acted on expectations that interest rate differentials between the drachma and foreign currencies will shrink in the future.

"Depos are holding morning levels in late trade but forex forwards are down 30 pips in long tenors," said a trader at a foreign bank. "Players seem to believe that Greek and foreign interest rate differentials will narrow in the future."
The central bank drained overnight funds at an unchanged 12.60 percent.
Early elections are to be held on September 22 but the market has taken a positive attitude towards them on the grounds that the winner will have no option but to follow Greece's EU convergence plan.
The mark was quoted at 159.90/00 drachmas from Tuesday's 159.945 fix, the dollar at 236.01/11 drachmas from 235.730 and the Ecu at 300.85/95 from 300.900 drachmas.
"There was two way trading at the fixing with nothing exceptional happening," said a forex dealer at a foreign bank.
